title: How the Duna Kör Mobilized Tens of Thousands in 1988
grammar: Purposive postpositions: érdekében ('in the interest of / for the purpose of')
goal: I can narrate the formation of the Duna Kör (1984) and the historic 1988 mass demonstrations in Budapest.
I can form formal purposive clauses using érdekében with possessive verbal nouns and nominal phrases.
I can debate how environmental activism functioned as a catalyst for political democratization.
